E0063.explanation:
'static var' declared outside a function body.

A function-static variable is C's ``static`` local: it belongs to one weave
and is created once.  Declaring it in a ``test`` block, at module top level,
or nested inside a conditional has no coherent C translation, so it is
rejected on placement rather than on type.

This used to share ``E0035`` with the "name collides with a C reserved word"
diagnostic -- two conditions with nothing in common, which made a
code-based quick-fix impossible (roadmap Phase 7, item 7.2).

guidance.help: Move the 'static var' declaration to the top level of the function body.
guidance.note: Function-static variables must be direct children of the function body.

conditions: Test name must be a non-empty string or identifier

a ``test`` block has no usable name.

Unit tests are reported by name, so ``test`` with an empty or ``_``-only name
cannot be identified in the runner output.

This used to share ``E0035`` (roadmap Phase 7, item 7.2).

guidance.help: Give the test a descriptive name: 'test "does something"' or 'test does_something'.
guidance.note: Unit tests need a name for reporting.

conditions: Field '{}' collides with field '{}' in C code emission ('{}')
E0065.explanation:
two PenguScript fields map to the same C field name.

``_c_ident`` escapes C keywords by prefixing an underscore, so ``x`` and
``_x`` both emit the C field ``_x``.  The collision is between two *user*
fields, not with a C reserved word, which is why it is not ``E0035``.

This used to share ``E0035`` (roadmap Phase 7, item 7.2).

guidance.help: Rename one of the fields so their C identifiers differ.
guidance.note: PenguScript escapes C keywords by prefixing an underscore, which may clash with existing identifiers.

W0000.practice: None — infrastructure fallback, used when a warning string does not match the '[Wxxxx] message' shape.

conditions: transmute from '{}' ({} bytes) to '{}' ({} bytes) has size mismatch and is unsafe
transmute is unsafe, use 'to' for safe conversions
W0001.name: UnsafeTransmuteWarning
W0001.practice: Use safe 'to <Type>' casting where possible, or verify that the memory layout sizes match.

conditions: Echo union '{}' access is unsafe
W0002.name: UnsafeEchoAccessWarning
W0002.practice: Untagged union reads are inherently unsafe; prefer algebraic 'omen' variants with payloads.

conditions: Unreachable code in else branch
Unreachable code in then branch
W0004.name: UnreachableCodeWarning
W0004.practice: Remove dead code following unconditional returns or compile-time false branches.

conditions: Inconsistent indentation: line {} uses tabs, line {} uses spaces
Variable '{}' shadows global function '{}' on line {}
W0005.name: ShadowedGlobalWarning
W0005.practice: Rename the local, or qualify the call so the intent is explicit.

conditions: Symbol '{}' is deprecated
Symbol '{}' is deprecated: {}
W0006.name: DeprecatedSymbolWarning
W0006.practice: Migrate to the replacement named in the reason. CI can turn this into an error with --deny-deprecated.

conditions: 'unsafe:' block disables bounds/overflow checks on line {}
W0007.name: UnsafeBlockWarning
W0007.practice: Keep 'unsafe:' blocks as small as possible and document why they are sound.

conditions: '..' range syntax is deprecated; write 'a to b' instead on line {}
W0013.name: RangeSyntaxDeprecated
W0013.practice: Write 'a to b'. The '..' form keeps working through 1.x and is removed in 2.0.
